inputs.style: English, smoky low female vocal, moody guitar rock, overdriven lead electric guitar, driving sub bass, tight gated drums, heavy reverb and tape saturation, cinematic and melancholic, 104 BPM
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Cigarette burns along the dashboard
Three a.m. and the tank runs dry
You said forever like it cost you nothing
Cheapest little word to ever pass your lips

[Chorus]
So burn it down, burn it down
I don't want the ashes back
Every promise written in the smoke
Every road that turns to black

[Verse]
Streetlight bleeding through a broken window
Wearing your jacket like a loaded gun
I learned your language, learned to speak in exits
Learned the only way to win is not to run

[Chorus]
So burn it down, burn it down
I don't want the ashes back
Every promise written in the smoke
Every road that turns to black

[Bridge]
No saints left in this city
No mercy in the rain
I'd rather feel the fire
Than never feel again

[Chorus]
So burn it down, burn it down
I don't want the ashes back
Every promise written in the smoke
Every road that turns to black

[Outro]
Burn it down
Burn it down
